lines: A queen sent a fortune. He sent it back.
The Queen of Sheba said: I will send to them a gift, and see with what the messengers return.
Prophet Sulaiman, alayhis salaam, said: Do you provide me with wealth? What Allah has given me is better than what He has given you.
Rather, it is you who rejoice in your gift.
What Allah gave you is worth more than any gift. Thank Him for it today, before you ask for more.
